label: Mere-conservation rival of universal perfection transfer survives, checked
meaning: Rival test for universal perfection transfer against its smallest consumer, CausalPerfectionTransfer.reconstruction (premises: universal perfection transfer, residual transfer). With a universal source of esse and a secondary cause that alone causes a further perfection, the mere-conservation rival holds with the residual condition and the unrestricted transfer principle fails. Model-witnessed survival only; the existing four-role secondary-only interpretation does not satisfy the residual condition, so a new interpretation is used.
